Two full marked runs and a control agree. Named cells stayed at the stock value 3200.

The only writers that fill every index are the invalid-area boot rebuild and the debug console `size` / `set_def` commands. A valid save does not take the boot rebuild.

The recommended layout is six PEN-F tagged dwords `0x4831CCVV` in the index pairs listed in `work/out/verdict.md`. `work/result.md` and `work/evidence-manifest.json` are in place.The control run and the repeat of the full marker suite both finished successfully and agree with the earlier run.

Named cells stayed at 3200 in the control and in both marked runs. The 13 unnamed cells stayed at the marker in the marked runs and at 0 in the control, including after a new session on the same NVRAM file. That is the result already recorded in `work/out/verdict.md`: key `0x5b82` is ownable for those 13 cells.
